author: JohnHippie
quote: I demand my money back inmediatly. 25 hours in and is the worst game I have played since 2016. What happened Rockstar? What’s the strategy besides robbing me my money making a digital only game of this caliber? Maybe I’m an npc being robbed in gta real life. And metacritic, what a dissapointment of a review page. How do you dare to put this game above a masterpiece that deserved its place since 1998. People, I commend you to start buying books for enjoyment instead of games, let’s boycott this whole deal in a way that shall be remembered. We must do something, we gotta stop this corporation behavior.
